about_the_game:
Game Pillars

Labyrinth exploration: Explore and solve endless procedurally generated labyrinths of infinite levels in a fast-paced first-person action game: Everything is fast, you run, shoot and avoid anything that tries to slow you down while you try to beat the labyrinths in time.

Online leaderboards: The game is a single player game, but focuses on showing online leaderboards for players to compare their best times with other players' times.

Multimedia: Experience the game with both a PC desktop and VR through your favourite headset, feel the emotions inside the labyrinths in VR!

AI: Play against "AI", your main opponent. It is an alien AI that rules the world of LabyrAInth. It creates always different labyrinths and populates them with enemies, traps and more.

Game Objective

The aim of LabyrAInth is to enchant and absorb you in an alien world composed of infinite ever-changing labyrinths set to challenge your reflexes, memory and skills.

Your objectives throughout the game are

1. to escape from the labyrinths in the shortest possible time.

2. Fight your way out of every labyrinth, shooting enemies and traps that try to defeat you.

3. Upgrade your weapon and character stats.

4. Compete with other players on online leaderboards.

5. Complete the game's story.

Core Gameplay Mechanics

The game is a cross-genre between a labyrinth exploration game and an arcade FPS shooter with elements of RPG and elements on online competitive gaming.

Primarily, you will need to find the exit portal of the labyrinth. You will be equipped with a weapon to shoot traps and enemies. Inside the labyrinths you will find objects to avoid like traps and objects to obtain like collectibles, ammo, power-ups and weapon attachments.

Time is of the essence and is the core mechanic of the game. You have a fixed amount of time to find the exit for each level or you lose. Moreover, the prize for exiting a labyrinth is strictly dependent on the time it took to exit. Finally, the time taken to exit the labyrinth will be shown on global online leaderboards, so try to beat everyone by scoring the lowest time possible.

You will also be able to customise your main weapon, upgrade your character's main stats and access the in-game store where you can buy weapon attachments, energy cores and ammunition with the coins you earn while playing.

To summarize: level by level you will need to solve the next labyrinth by reaching and passing through the exit portal. You can only lose in two ways:

1 When the clock reaches zero.

2 When enemies and traps kill you.

Game Modes

  • The Story Mode: You are the protagonist of the game. You play the role of a character who was studying data from space to train an AI that tries to solve climate change, by doing so you were abducted to an alien planet and you will need to escape all the labyrinths to gain the knowledge of that planet to save planet Earth. This is a single player offline mode, so there are no leaderboards. There are a fixed number of levels for this game mode, each level has a different labyrinth and there are many different labyrinths configurations for the same level.

  • The Infinite Mode: boasts an infinite number of labyrinths always different to play until you cannot progress any further. This mode is paired with online leaderboards, so an internet connection is required to play this game mode. Hardcore players will get a taste of an infinite game with a slow but steady increase in difficulty that only the very best can master at high levels. Online leaderboards allow you to compare your best times with those of other players around the world. Will you reach the highest level anyone has ever reached?

  • The Ranked Mode: In this mode the levels are fixed and finite. There are only about 10 levels and they are the same for everyone. Each week a new set of levels will be given to the players and they will be the same for all players for the current week. There will also be a special rule that the game imposes for the current week. In addition, each week all progress and items unlocked in this game mode in the previous week will be reset. This is to ensure that everyone starts at the same level in this mode. This is an online only game mode. Players from around the world will race against time on the same labyrinths to try and achieve the best time they can against one another. There are online leaderboards too for this game mode. At the end of each week, the top players will receive a prize based on their final position on that week's leaderboard. Prizes can be used to purchase items for other game modes.

Actors inside the Labyrinths

You will not be alone in the labyrinths. The AI will populate them with many different types of actors:

  • Enemies: they are the aliens living in the world of LabyrAInth created by the AI. They are its children and obey it. There are many different types of actors, some weaker and others stronger than the others, but their behavior is the same: to patrol the labyrinths until they hear or see you, when that happens, they will chase you and then attack you when you least expect them! Will you be able to defeat them all?

  • Traps: The world of LabyrAInth is full of insidious traps set by the AI with the objective to slow you down or beat you up. As you progress through the game, you will come across many more and more powerful traps, ready to trigger and activate at the last moment. Some of them can be destroyed, others can only be avoided. Will you learn to deal with them?

  • Power-ups: Inside the labyrinths you will also find many different power-ups that activate instantly and give you increased powers for a brief amount of time! You will certainly learn how to make the most use of them and choose when to pick them up and activate them inside the labyrinths. Will you survive in the labyrinths?

RPG elements

As the game progresses and the levels become more difficult, you will become more powerful, increasing your chances of survival. Indeed, in the labyrinths you are equipped with a great weapon that you can upgrade by attaching several components to it. These components can come in different rarities; higher rarities are harder to find, but will make your main weapon more powerful.

Your main weapon can fire different types of projectiles. You may find projectile orbs in the labyrinths to replenish your projectile count.

Between each level, you can upgrade your character's stats. It's up to you how you want to play the game, whether you prefer a faster and more agile character, or a stronger and more robust one.

The game rewards you for your actions in a variety of ways. Depending on your score at the end of a level, you will receive coins as a prize. Coins can also be earned by killing enemies, destroying traps and participating in online leaderboards. These coins can be used to purchase character upgrades, new ammo and new weapon components.

LabyrAInthVR the VR game

The game supports both Windows PC and VR headsets. Play with your favourite VR headset in LabyrAInthVR, the VR version of the game. In LabyrAInthVR, everything is essentially the same as the normal PC version of the game, except that the user interaction is adapted for an immersive and true VR experience, the UIs are slightly different to accommodate the VR POV and some game mechanics are made closer to reality, such as changing components on the weapon: you have to physically detach and attach them to your main weapon.

Due to the lack of ownership of every VR headset on the market, we have designed all VR features to support any VR controller input, but we have fully tested and therefore we officially support only the following headsets: Oculus Rift, Oculus Quest 2 and 3, and HP Reverb G2. Feel free to contact us if you experience any problems with your VR headset.

Important note: Game saves and therefore your game progress are separate between the PC and VR versions of the game for the Infinite and the Ranked game modes! (In the Story mode, the save file is shared between the PC and VR versions). So, choose carefully which version of the game you want to play! Online leaderboards will only show the scores of players for the same version of the game that you are playing, they will not be shared between the PC and VR versions!

Infinite Replayability

The levels of the game are always different; you will never find a labyrinth equal to another, even if they are of the same difficulty: They are always different. There are infinite labyrinths of infinite levels. This means LabyrAInth has an infinite replayability.

About the Team of LabyrAInth

We are a small indie group of passionate Italian game developers. We developed this game out of passion, in our spare time, as we are actually software developers. We designed and programmed all the features of the game. Since we are software developers, we have no artists between us, so all the graphical assets for this game was bought online, made by third parties, and we put everything together to make it blend harmoniously into the game. Our focus is to give you a great gameplay experience!
This is our first time releasing a title publicly on Steam, so we're giving it to you for free. Please be kind to us.

We loved making and playing this game, and we really hope you'll love it too.

legal_notice:
LabyrAInth - Privacy Policy

Last Updated: 29/04/2025

1. Data Collection

When you play LabyrAInth, we collect only the minimum data necessary to provide game functionality:

Steam User ID – Used for authentication and account linking.
Game Statistics – Data related to gameplay, such as progress and achievements.
Game Saves – Stored via Steam Cloud to maintain your game progress.

2. How We Use Your Data

LabyrAInth connects to Steam for authentication, game saves, and online functionality.
Game saves are handled through Steam Cloud.
A proprietary game server processes game logic but does not store additional personal data beyond what is required for gameplay.

3. Data Sharing & Security

We do not sell, rent, or share your data with third parties.
All data is stored securely through Steam and our proprietary server, following industry-standard security measures.

4. Your Rights & Control

Since we only collect essential data, opting out of data collection may render online features inaccessible.
Data stored on Steam (e.g., saves, achievements) is subject to Steam’s privacy policies.

5. Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy if necessary. Continued use of LabyrAInth after changes means you accept the updated terms.

If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact labyrainthpcvr@gmail.com.

By playing LabyrAInth, you agree to this Privacy Policy.

  • VR Support: OpenXR, SteamVR

short_description: LabyrAInth is a sci-fi fps game focused on the exploration of labyrinths. You are trapped in an infinite series of ever-changing labyrinths trying to escape. Avoid traps, shoot enemies, collect resources, gear-up, activate power ups, and most importantly escape the labyrinth, racing against time.
